title: Material 3 Chip Visual Diagnostics Packet v1
problem: Closed the AssistChip, SuggestionChip, FilterChip, and InputChip visual follow-on by adding a focused gallery diagnostics script that proves representative chip root/chrome geometry and trailing-icon selector readiness.

repro.summary: Run the Material3 State Matrix chip visual chrome diagnostics script against the UI Gallery.
commands: cargo run -p fretboard-dev -- diag run tools/diag-scripts/ui-gallery/material3/ui-gallery-material3-chip-visual-chrome.json --dir target/fret-diag/material3-chip-visual-chrome-20260528 --session-auto --pack --ai-packet --exit-after-run --timeout-ms 900000 --launch -- cargo run -p fret-ui-gallery --features gallery-material3

gates.name: chip-visual-chrome-diag
gates.command: cargo run -p fretboard-dev -- diag run tools/diag-scripts/ui-gallery/material3/ui-gallery-material3-chip-visual-chrome.json --dir target/fret-diag/material3-chip-visual-chrome-20260528 --session-auto --pack --ai-packet --exit-after-run --timeout-ms 900000 --launch -- cargo run -p fret-ui-gallery --features gallery-material3

gates.name: chip-automation-surface
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-material3 --features diagnostics --test automation_surface material3_segmented_buttons_and_chips_expose_stable_part_test_ids

continue_policy.notes: Chip visual chrome diagnostics are closed for representative flat/elevated/selected/trailing-icon gallery states. Keep shared indication and minimum target helpers in Material foundation.
